title: Poland's Fiscal Credibility Under Pressure · 24 Oct
keywords: Poland, fiscal deficit, Fitch Ratings, sovereign credit rating, negative outlook, budget, defense spending, inflation, fuel prices, cost of living, EU fiscal rules, National Bank of Poland, Warsaw, European Union, public finances
notes: Poland faces mounting questions over the sustainability of its public finances after Fitch Ratings assigned a negative outlook to its A- sovereign rating, citing a general-government deficit expected to reach 6.9% of GDP in 2026. The government's case rests on security imperatives and economic resilience, but critics argue that pre-election spending and political paralysis are crowding out credible fiscal reform. Meanwhile, fuel-price interventions designed to ease household pressures have failed to push inflation below 4%, complicating both the budgetary picture and the central bank's task.
